describe.description: The creature is a single, slender, four-legged equine shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. Its body is covered in short brown hair that is darker along the back and mane and lighter on the belly and inner legs, with a white patch on the muzzle. It has a long head with a narrow muzzle, two very long upright ears, a short bristly upright mane along the neck, a thin tail with a dark tuft at the end, and four slender legs ending in single hooves. No other animals, objects, or background elements are visible.

describe.description: A brown donkey-like equid standing in right-facing side profile against a plain light background. It has a slender brown body with a lighter belly and inner legs, a long neck topped with a short upright dark mane, a long narrow head with a white muzzle, very long upright ears, and a thin tail ending in a dark tuft. It stands on four slender legs ending in single hooves.
